company.about: Roomcreator and Design Co., Ltd. builds custom homes, sells new homes, and renovates older houses in Thailand.

headline: Your home,
built right,
from plan to keys
hero.lead: We design and build homes on your land, sell new homes our team has finished, and renovate older houses. One contract, one team, weekly progress updates.

services.title: Custom Home Construction
services.desc: We build on your land: structure, systems, and finishes, under one fixed contract with weekly progress reports.

services.title: Design & Building Permits
services.desc: Floor plans, 3D views, engineering drawings, and permit submission, so construction starts on paper first.

services.title: New Homes for Sale
services.desc: Finished homes built by our own crews. Visit the house, check the work, and move in.

services.title: Renovation
services.desc: Upgrade or rebuild an older house, from a new kitchen to new structure, wiring, and roof.

process.title: Site visit & brief
process.desc: We visit your land, check access, soil, and drainage, and listen to how your family lives.

process.title: Design & quote
process.desc: Floor plans and 3D views, then an itemised quote with materials listed by brand and grade.

process.title: Contract & permit
process.desc: Fixed-price contract with payments tied to finished stages. We prepare and submit the permit.

process.title: Construction
process.desc: Foundation, structure, roof, systems, finishes. Photos and a progress report every week.

process.title: Inspection & handover
process.desc: We walk the house with you, fix every item on the list, then hand over the keys and warranty.
